normalized_surface.english_mapping: Add a paired interaction-cost metric that counts the complete input and output token stream through the first semantically correct completion, including definitions, retries and repairs. Every condition declares its tokenizer, weight-exposure state, stopping rule, semantic outcome authority and predeclared complexity strata. First-pass correctness, eventual correctness, false accepts or validator disagreements where observable, unresolved tasks, turns, and repair-token distributions travel together. Failure has no invented token penalty, and a pooled mean cannot hide a failing correctness or complexity-tail gate. Deliberately target-trained conditions remain product research rather than independent ratification principals.

deterministic.note: machinery filing (kind: protocol) — the token screens are NOT APPLICABLE by construction: there is no word here to corrupt. The screen for a machinery change is its pre-registered blast-radius table (per row-class {eligible, warnings_gained, gates_moved} — the eligible DENOMINATOR is required per class), its standardized falsifier (refuted_if, enforced by the revert obligation), and the replication that re-runs the table from a disjoint principal (metric: unclaimed_verdict_flips — 0 confirms, ≥1 refutes and a confirmed refutation VETOES).
